article.story: Iowa State (4-4) at Baylor (5-3), Nov. 7 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Baylor by 9.5. Against the spread: Baylor 6-2, Iowa State 3-4-1. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Baylor Offense Overall: 434.8 yards per game (32nd in FBS) Passing: 283.9 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 150.9 yards per game (77th) Scoring: 30.6 points per game (54th) Baylor Defense Overall: 332.8 yards per game (44th in FBS) Passing: 233.4 yards per game (98th) Rushing: 99.4 yards per game (17th) Scoring: 15.3 points per game (12th) Iowa State Offense Overall: 370 yards per game (78th in FBS) Passing: 193.4 yards per game (106th) Rushing: 176.6 yards per game (43rd) Scoring: 29 points per game (65th) Iowa State Defense Overall: 390.5 yards per game (102nd in FBS) Passing: 231.3 yards per game (97th) Rushing: 159.3 yards per game (93rd) Scoring: 27.3 points per game (97th) Iowa State is 122nd in third down percentage, converting 33% of the time. Baylor ranks 29th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 32.3%. Baylor ranks 128th in the FBS averaging 75.3 penalty yards per game, compared to Iowa State's 40th-ranked 48.4 per-game average. Iowa State leads the FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 100% of trips. Team leaders Baylor Passing: D.J. Lagway, 1,671 yards, 13 TDs, 4 INTs, 53.3 completion percentage Rushing: Dawson Pendergrass, 339 yards on 94 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Gavin Freeman, 792 yards on 63 catches, 3 TDs Iowa State Passing: Jaylen Raynor, 1,416 yards, 10 TDs, 5 INTs, 59.7 completion percentage Rushing: Aiden Flora, 937 yards on 131 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Jamal Polite Jr., 286 yards on 14 catches, 2 TDs Last game Baylor defeated UCF 41-9 on Oct. 30. Lagway threw for 319 yards on 16-of-25 attempts (64.0%) with four touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 11 times for 23 yards. Ryelan Morris had 82 rushing yards on 11 carries. Freeman had five receptions for 114 yards and one touchdown. Iowa State defeated Oklahoma State 51-49 on Oct. 31. Raynor led Iowa State with 309 yards on 18-of-28 passing (64.3%) for three touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 12 times for 48 yards and one rushing touchdown. Flora carried the ball 29 times for 221 yards and scored two touchdowns. Polite had six receptions for 171 yards and one touchdown. Next game Baylor plays at No. 7 BYU on Nov. 14. Iowa State hosts Cincinnati on Nov. 14.

articles.headline: Arizona grabs onside kick, hits late FG to pull out TCU win
articles.description: Arizona recovers an onside kick to setup a 37-yard field goal with under a minute to go as the Wildcats stunned TCU 29-28.

articles.headline: Salgado-Medina makes field goal after recovered onside pooch kick, No. 24 Arizona stuns TCU 29-28
articles.description: — Michael Salgado-Medina kicked a 37-yard field goal with 39 seconds left after No. 24 Arizona recovered an onside pooch kick and the Wildcats pulled out an improbable 29-28 victory over TCU early Saturday.

articles.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska
articles.description: — Collin Dixon caught two touchdown passes including a record-breaker and Illinois used a trick play to set up its go-ahead TD as the Illini defeated Nebraska 24-13 on Friday night to become bowl eligible with their fourth straight victory.
